newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - July 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - July 2.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- The newspaper frontpages celebrations in Beijing held to mark the handover of Hong Kong to Chinese rule.
- Full text of a speech made by President Jiang Zemin at the official celebrations in Beijing to mark the return of Hong Kong.
- A central bank official calls for stricter measures against the illegal sale of the renminbi currency.
- A survey by the State Technical Supervision Bureau shows only 57.5 percent of cotton seeds meet quality standards.
- The Kowloon Customs House on the border with Hong Kong is renamed Shenzhen Customs House.
